distance_from_cbd: 25 km (16 mi) east of Melbourne CBD
housing_building_stock_character: Established outer-east suburb that grew from a 19th-century railway town with post-WWII subdivisions; a major transport hub with newer multi-storey housing development appearing near the station/Ringwood Lake.
source_quotes: Ringwood recorded a population of 19,144 at the 2021 census.
This development boomed post war, causing the City of Ringwood to be declared in 1960.
After the successful post-depression subdivisions of land in the area, Ringwood was recognised to be a part of metropolitan Melbourne.
In 2009, the State Government controversially approved the building of a nine-storey housing development near Ringwood Lake.
